text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Awright! The time has finally come!
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Us too! And everyone else!
All of us who've worked hard up to this day
are about to clash head-on!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just imagine how intense this match is gonna be...!
Ah jeez, my blood's pumping so hard, I can't sit still!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Mind if I put you on my shoulders
and do some squats!?
choice_data_list: H-hold on until the race starts!
H-hold on until the race starts, okay!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! You're right! We've built up all this passion, after all!
Alright then—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna unleash all this heat in the race!! Full-throttle, all the waaaay!!
